claims.quote: Pethia aurea is a small cyprinid known from ponds in South 24 Parganas District, West Bengal, in the Ganges delta of northern India.
Currently known only from a series of ponds in South 24 Parganas District, West Bengal state, northern India, in the Ganges River delta region.
